title: fix(scripts): error-status conformance walk skips an entry that vanished between readdir and stat
body:
Fixes #20225

Clause-②: no

## What changed

One file: `scripts/check-error-status-conformance.mjs`.

- `walk()` now stats each listed entry through `statListedEntry()`. That function tolerates exactly one error: `ENOENT` from the stat of an entry that the parent's `readdirSync` just listed, and only when an `lstat` cannot find the entry either. In that case the entry VANISHED and is skipped. Every other error still throws.
- `--self-test` gains battery 28, with 10 cases on real disk. The roster floor goes from 28 to 29 and the case total from 60 to 70.
- `deriveWireFace()` keeps its signature, so `check-error-status-conformance.d.mts` is unchanged.
- No package source changes and no published surface moves. Root scripts live in the private root package, so this PR carries no changeset.

## Why: the mechanism, measured

- `packages/spec/src/api/error-catalog-docs.test.ts` calls `deriveWireFace()` from `@objectstack/spec#test:repo`. CI's `Test Core` job runs `pnpm turbo run test test:repo` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`). That turbo invocation also builds packages while the walk runs, because the test tasks depend on `^build`.
- tsup 8.5.1 loads its config through bundle-require 5.1.0. bundle-require writes `tsup.config.bundled_ID.mjs` next to the config, imports it and unlinks it (`getOutputFile` and `unlink` in `bundle-require/dist/index.js`). Vite 8.0.16 writes its bundled config under `node_modules/.vite-temp/` instead, and the walk skips `node_modules`.
- The old `walk()` called `readdirSync` and then a bare `statSync` on each entry. An entry the listing named could be gone before its stat ran.

## Reproduced first, on `origin/main`

The probe lives in the scratchpad and is not committed. A sibling process loops create and unlink of `packages/spec/tsup.config.bundled_probe.mjs`, while `deriveWireFace(worktree)` runs in the parent. The "before" module is a byte-identical copy of the script at `443b2f4f` (blob `e31c273b`). The "after" module is a copy of this PR's head `1c249be6` (blob `309db59a`, equal to `git rev-parse HEAD:scripts/check-error-status-conformance.mjs`). Both legs ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

| leg | module | runs | ok | ENOENT |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| control, no churn | `443b2f4f` | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| churn | `443b2f4f` | 8 | 4 | **4**: `ENOENT: no such file or directory, stat '…/packages/spec/tsup.config.bundled_probe.mjs'` at `walk (check-error-status-conformance.mjs:1832:15)` |
| churn | `1c249be6` (this PR) | **24** | **24** | **0** |

Every run that finished read **2674** sources, in all three legs. The churner was stopped after each leg, and no probe file was left behind (`leftBehind: false` in both churn legs).

## The rule: what it skips and what still throws

| case | answer | pinned by |
|---|---|---|
| a listed entry that is gone (stat ENOENT, then lstat ENOENT) | skipped | 28, 28b, 28c |
| absent at the stat, back under the same name by the lstat (not a symlink) | scanned as present; lstat IS its stat | 28d |
| a dangling symlink (stat ENOENT, lstat finds the link) | **throws** `ENOENT` from `stat`. Skipping it would shrink the corpus, the same case `check-startup-registry-verdict.mjs` pins as "an error, not a smaller corpus" | 28e |
| `ENOTDIR` | **throws** (produced for real: the listed directory is replaced by a file) | 28f |
| `EACCES` on the stat | **throws** (injected: root bypasses permission bits, and CI and this container run as root) | 28g |
| `ENOENT` on the stat, then any other error on the lstat | **throws** that error (injected) | 28h |
| a missing scan ROOT | **throws** `ENOENT` naming the root | 28i |
| nothing vanishing | every source-shaped file is read, including the one the churn deleted | 28j |

- The rule does not match on names, because the next transient file will have a different one.
- `statSync(p, { throwIfNoEntry: false })` is not this rule. Measured on Node v22.22.2, it also answers `undefined` for `ENOTDIR` and for a dangling symlink.
- The header states what is **not** covered. A listed directory that vanishes before its own `readdirSync` still throws, and so does a pushed `.ts` file that vanishes before `readFileSync`. No producer of either was found under the scan root.

The self-test's success line gains this clause, quoted verbatim:

> … and the corpus walk skips an entry that VANISHED between readdir and stat (every present file still scanned) while a dangling symlink, ENOTDIR, a permission error and a missing root still throw.

### The pins can fail: five ablations

For each ablation the fix was committed first. The mutation went through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, where the anchor must hit once and the blob must change. After each run the file was restored to the HEAD blob `309db59a`, and `git diff HEAD` came back empty.

| ablation | expected red | observed |
|---|---|---|
| 1 vanished → rethrow (no tolerance) | 28, 28b, 28c | `3/70 case(s) failed`: 28, 28b (`enoent=1`), 28c (`no corpus`) |
| 2 drop the dangling-symlink throw | 28e | `1/70`: 28e (`ENOENT open …/dangling.ts`: it failed at the read, not at the stat) |
| 3 swallow every stat error | 28f, 28g | `2/70`: 28f, 28g |
| 4 naive ENOENT swallow (no lstat) | 28d, 28e, 28h | `3/70`: 28d, 28e, 28h |
| 5 tolerate ENOENT on the ROOT listing | 28i | `1/70`: 28i |

## Local verification (head `1c249be6`)

- `node scripts/check-error-status-conformance.mjs --self-test`: `✓ … 70 cases pass`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project repo --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose src/api/error-catalog-docs.test.ts`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 5 passed (5)`. All five `error-catalog.mdx ↔ the published wire face` cases are green.
- The gate families derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this branch are identical to the dispatch's list (30 commands).
- All 30 were run at `1c249be6`. Every exit code was written to disk before it was read, and all 30 are `0`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE` answers `Run reconciliation — 30 derived, 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` and `✓ … (a DERIVED zero — all 30 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. The list includes `pnpm check:error-status-conformance` (self-test plus the real run), `check:entry-guard`, `check:parse-guard`, `check:declaration-mirrors` (+ `--self-test`), `check:self-test-wired` (+ `--self-test`) and `check:nul-bytes`.
- The full CI farm is CI's job; this list is the derived subset, not an enumeration of `lint.yml`.

## Acceptance notes

### Census: every readdir-then-stat walker in `scripts/**` and `packages/*/scripts/**`

Method: `git ls-files` over both globs gives 474 script files. Of those, 183 call `readdirSync`/`readdir(`, and 85 also call a stat. Every hit was read. A walker **can race a transient file** only when two things hold: it scans a tree that a build writes transient entries into (a package root or `dist/`), **and** it runs concurrently with that build. In CI, concurrency exists only inside a turbo invocation that mixes build and test tasks. So the second half was measured on these surfaces: package tests that import or spawn a repo script, package `build`/`test` npm scripts, and turbo `inputs`.

**Fixed here (1).** `scripts/check-error-status-conformance.mjs` `walk()`. It scans `packages/` and runs inside `@objectstack/spec#test:repo`, and its race was reproduced above.

**Same shape, over a tree a build writes to, but never concurrent with a build. Recorded, not fixed.** On every path that runs them, each is a sequential CI step (`lint.yml`, the type-check job) or a manual command. No package test or build script runs any of them on the real tree: the package tests that reach `check-regen-pending.mjs` pass sandbox directories. They would race only if someone ran the gate while a build ran in the same worktree.
- `packages/` walks with a bare per-entry `statSync`:
  - `packages/spec/scripts/check-error-code-provenance.ts` `collectSourceFiles`
  - `scripts/check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs` `walkManifests`, `walkSources`
  - `scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs` `collectPackageProseFiles`
  - `scripts/check-error-code-casing.mjs` `walk`
  - `scripts/check-init-service-contract.mjs` `walk`
  - `scripts/check-objectql-double-limit.mjs` `testFilesUnder`
  - `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` (two walks)
  - `scripts/check-runtime-services-index.mjs` `walk`
  - `scripts/check-settings-bind-window.mjs` `walk`
  - `scripts/check-single-authz-resolver.mjs` `walk`
  - `scripts/check-startup-registry-verdict.mjs` `collectSourceFiles`
  - `scripts/check-where-matcher-conformance.mjs` `testFilesUnder`
  - `scripts/check-wildcard-fallthrough.mjs` `walk`
- Whole-repo walks:
  - `scripts/check-parse-guard.mjs` `walkOutside`
  - `scripts/check-watch-hint-literal.mjs` `walk`
- Dirent walks that stat each matched file for its mtime:
  - `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` `newestSourceMtime`
  - `scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs` `newestMtime` (spec `dist/`, `json-schema/`, `src/`). Its real-tree callers are `build-docs.ts`, `check-generated.ts` and `lib/dist-freshness.ts`, and each runs after a build.
  - `packages/spec/scripts/check-generated.ts` `declarationFiles`. It reads `dist/` after the forced build it performs itself, in the same process.

**Same shape, over trees no build writes to. Cannot race a build transient.**
- `src`-only roots:
  - `packages/spec/scripts/build-docs.ts:136`
  - `packages/spec/scripts/category-title.test.ts:47`
  - `packages/spec/scripts/check-duration-unit-keys.ts`
  - `scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs` `walkTsInto`
  - `scripts/check-kernel-hook-pairs.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-meta-type-normalized.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-spec-parsed-alias.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs` `collectSpecSourceFiles`
  - the sibling-directory `find`s at `check-objectql-double-limit.mjs:1283` and `check-where-matcher-conformance.mjs:1018`
  - `packages/spec/scripts/check-llms-txt.ts` `readWorkspacePackages`, which stats listed package directories
- Docs, skills, `.claude` and `.github` roots:
  - `scripts/check-corpus-claim-drift.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs` `walk`, `collectPublishedSkillFiles`
  - `scripts/check-doc-route-spelling.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-docs-spec-enumerations.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-role-word.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-skill-frame-sync.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-workflow-step-name-quoting.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs` `walkActionFiles`
  - `scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs`
  - `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` `tierValueSites`
  - `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`
- `scripts/` roots:
  - `scripts/check-entry-guard.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-parse-guard.mjs` `walk`
  - `scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs` `walkScripts`
  - `scripts/pm/measurement-claim-triage.mjs`
- A manual codemod, run on a root the user names: `scripts/codemod/apimethods-legacy-to-primitives.mjs`.

**Already tolerant, through a catch-all around the stat.** This is broader than `ENOENT`, which is a different concern from this card's:
- `scripts/audits/14744-before-update-per-row-value-census.mjs` (two walks)
- `scripts/check-cli-command-ids.mjs` (two walks)
- `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs`
- `scripts/check-logger-receiver-detach.mjs`
- `scripts/check-optional-error-sink-contract.mjs`
- `scripts/check-page-declaration-shape.mjs`
- `scripts/codemod/view-to-viewitem.mjs`
- `scripts/report-test-timings.mjs`
- `scripts/publish-smoke.sh`
- `packages/spec/scripts/analyze-bundle-size.ts` (`getFileSize`)

**Not the shape.** The remaining files list entries with `readdirSync(…, { withFileTypes: true })`, so no stat runs per entry, or they stat only a root or a fixed path. That includes `packages/spec/scripts/lazify-schemas.ts`, `scripts/check-dts-closure.mjs` and `scripts/check-sourcemap-no-sources-content.mjs`, whose only stat is of the root before listing it.

**Shared helper (Zone 2.4).** Only one walker needed the tolerance, so the three-walker threshold was not met. No new shared module was created, and `scripts/lib/**` holds no readdir/stat helper today (none of its files is among the 85).

### Outside this card's file surface (noted, not fixed)

- Test files under `packages/**/src` that walk the repo with a bare readdir-then-stat are outside the census globs and outside the claim, which allows no `packages/**/src` change. 12 test files call both `readdirSync` and `statSync` on a repo-rooted path. One of them walks the whole of `packages/` from inside a turbo test task: `packages/lint/src/lint-startup-registry-verdict.corpus.test.ts` `collectSourceFiles(packagesDir)`, in `@objectstack/lint#test`. I extracted that function verbatim from the file, transpiled it with esbuild and ran it over the real `packages/` under the same churn. It threw `ENOENT … stat '…/packages/spec/tsup.config.bundled_probe.mjs'` in **4 of 8** runs, while the other 4 read 2688 files. It is the same mechanism as this card. It is reported to the seat for routing, and it is not fixed here.
- `check-error-status-conformance.mjs`'s own `scanSources` reads each pushed file with `readFileSync`, and the recursion calls `readdirSync` on each listed directory. Neither is covered, as the header states, because no producer was found. The measured one (`tsup.config.bundled_ID.mjs`) is `.mjs` and is filtered out before the read.
